package.name: qodo
package.description: Qodo code intelligence, review, and organizational standards for local coding agents.

installPackages.name: qodo
installPackages.description: Qodo setup, code intelligence, and review workflows.

antigravity.description: Set up Qodo, explore code and repository history, review local changes, and resolve pull-request findings directly from Antigravity.
suggestedPrompts: Connect my Qodo account and verify this coding agent is ready.
Explain how this code works, including its history and cross-repository impact.
Review my local changes with Qodo before I push them.

installPackages.name: qodo-standards
installPackages.description: Optional Qodo standards discovery and review rules/skills administration workflows.

antigravity.description: Find Qodo coding standards relevant to your work, discover review skills, and manage review rules and skill setup for target repositories from Antigravity.
suggestedPrompts: Load the Qodo coding standards relevant to this task.
Capture this convention as a Qodo Review standard.
Set up review skills from our shared skills repository.

skills.name: qodo-setup
skills.shortDescription: Connect the Qodo runtime and verify this agent is ready.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-setup to connect my Qodo account and verify this coding agent.

skills.name: qodo-codebase-wisdom
skills.shortDescription: Understand code, history, and cross-repo impact.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-codebase-wisdom to explain how this code works and cite the evidence.

skills.name: qodo-get-rules
skills.shortDescription: Load the standards that apply to the current change.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-get-rules to load the Qodo standards relevant to this task.

skills.name: qodo-manage-standards
skills.shortDescription: Discover and manage review rules and skills.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-manage-standards to set up review rules and skills for my repositories.

skills.name: qodo-review
skills.shortDescription: Review coding milestones and local changes before handoff.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-review to review my local changes before I push them.

skills.name: qodo-review-resolver
skills.shortDescription: Read, audit and resolve Qodo PR findings with citation evidence.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-review-resolver to show me the current Qodo review findings.

skills.name: qodo-review-notes
skills.shortDescription: Maintain development tracks and PR reviewer context.
skills.defaultPrompt: Use $qodo-review-notes to find the development track and publish PR Review Notes.
